text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both slightly down over 24 hours in a choppy session, with BTC holding above $75k while ETH dips to $2,232, signaling mild seller pressure across the major pairs. The Fear & Greed index at 28 reflects genuine fear conditions that have intensified over the past week, though volume remains moderate at $30B. Bitcoin dominance at 59.3% suggests capital is rotating cautiously rather than fleeing to alts, consistent with a risk-off mood that hasn't yet triggered panic selling.
